# load and wrangle data 
```{r}
datapath <- "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/Behvaiour"
list_of_data <- list.files(
  path = datapath,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
Data_Behv <- read_csv(list_of_data, id = "group")
# extract id from filename, remove videos with more than 2 missing frames
Data_Behv <- Data_Behv %>%
  mutate(id = str_extract(Data_Behv$group, "M\\d+_\\d+")) %>%
  unite("Trial2", id, Trial, remove = F) %>%
  group_by(Trial2) %>%
  mutate(maxframe = max(framenumber)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(maxframe > 698)




Behv_diff <- Data_Behv %>%
  select(`whisker_tip@@x`:`whisker_tip@@likelihood`, framenumber:id) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub(".*@@", "", .), starts_with("whisker_tip")) %>%
  filter(Behv != "W2T") %>%
  mutate(triggerframe = 500 - Time_Difference * 200) %>%
  mutate(triggerframe = round(triggerframe * 200) / 200) %>%
  group_by(Trial2) %>%
  mutate(x = ifelse(likelihood < 0.9,
    (lead(x, default = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) + lag(x, default = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) / 2, x
  )) %>%
  mutate(y = ifelse(likelihood < 0.9,
    (lead(y, default = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)) + lag(y, default = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))) / 2, y
  )) %>%
  select(!likelihood) %>%
  group_by(Trial2) %>%
  mutate(mx = mean(x), my = mean(y)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(x2 = x - mx, y2 = y - my) %>%
  mutate(framenumber = framenumber / 200, triggerframe = triggerframe / 200)


Behv_diff2 <- Behv_diff %>%
  group_by(Trial2) %>%
  arrange(framenumber) %>%
  # 2. compute trapezoidal‐area for each segment in x & y
  mutate(
    area_x_seg = (abs(x2) + lead(abs(x2))) / 2,
    area_y_seg = (abs(y2) + lead(abs(y2))) / 2
  ) %>%
  # 3. total area is just the sum of all these segment‐areas
  mutate(
    total_area_x = sum(area_x_seg, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_area_y = sum(area_y_seg, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # 4. cumulative area up to each frame
  mutate(
    cum_area_x = cumsum(replace_na(area_x_seg, 0)),
    cum_area_y = cumsum(replace_na(area_y_seg, 0))
  ) %>%
  # 5. percent covered up to each frame
  mutate(
    pct_cov_x = cum_area_x / total_area_x * 100,
    pct_cov_y = cum_area_y / total_area_y * 100
  ) %>%
  # 6. per-frame percent = current pct – previous frame’s pct
  mutate(
    pc_x = pct_cov_x - lag(pct_cov_x, default = 0),
    pc_y = pct_cov_y - lag(pct_cov_y, default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Behv_diff %>% distinct(Trial2)
```

# C

```{r}
max <- Behv_diff2 %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  group_by(Trial2) %>%
  mutate(newframe = round((framenumber - triggerframe) * 200) / 200) %>%
  summarise(g = range(newframe)) %>%
  filter(g > 0) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_min(g, with_ties = F) %>%
  pull(g)
min <- Behv_diff2 %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  group_by(Trial2) %>%
  mutate(newframe = round((framenumber - triggerframe) * 200) / 200) %>%
  summarise(g = range(newframe)) %>%
  filter(g < 0) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_max(g, with_ties = F) %>%
  pull(g)




comb_coord <- Behv_diff2 %>%
  select(framenumber, x2, y2, pc_x, pc_y, triggerframe, Behv, Trial2, id) %>%
  mutate(chunks = case_when(
    between(framenumber, triggerframe, triggerframe + 0.255) ~ "Airpuff",
    between(framenumber, triggerframe + 0.256, triggerframe + 0.505) ~ "Post_Airpuff",
    TRUE ~ "Base" # Default case if none of the above conditions are met
  )) %>%
  mutate(diff3 = (pc_x + pc_y) / 2) %>%
  ungroup()



# 50 ms bins with se
n_trials_A2L <- comb_coord %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  distinct(Trial2) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  pull(n)


A2Lplot_data <- comb_coord %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  # Bin time (50 ms bins, consistent)
  mutate(
    bin_time = floor((framenumber - triggerframe) / 0.05) * 0.05
  ) %>%
  filter(between(bin_time, min, 2.5)) %>%
  # Step 1: average within trial
  group_by(Trial2, bin_time) %>%
  summarise(
    trial_bin_speed = mean(diff3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Step 2: average across trials
  group_by(bin_time) %>%
  summarise(
    percm = mean(trial_bin_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(trial_bin_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(), # number of trials contributing
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# Plot
A2Lplot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(bin_time, percm)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = percm - se, ymax = percm + se),
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.255) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.505) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100 / 700, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 50)
```

# D
```{r}
ntrial <- comb_coord %>%
  group_by(Behv) %>%
  summarise(ntrial = n_distinct(Trial2))


plot_df2 <- comb_coord %>%
  filter(Behv != "W2T") %>%
  # Use floor for consistent 50ms binning
  mutate(bin_time = floor((framenumber - triggerframe) / 0.05) * 0.05) %>%
  # Step 1: Average within each bin for each Trial
  group_by(Behv, Trial2, bin_time) %>%
  summarise(trial_bin_speed = mean(diff3, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Step 2: Average across trials
  group_by(Behv, bin_time) %>%
  summarise(
    percm = mean(trial_bin_speed),
    sd = sd(trial_bin_speed), # This is the variation between trials
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Step 3: Baseline Correction
  group_by(Behv) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline = mean(percm[bin_time < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    percm_bc = percm - baseline
  ) %>%
  left_join(ntrial, by = "Behv") %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(ntrial))




ggplot(plot_df2, aes(bin_time, percm_bc, col = Behv)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = percm_bc - se, ymax = percm_bc + se, fill = Behv), alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0.255)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0.505)) +
  xlim(-0.2, 1.24) +
  xlab("Time from Airpuff [s]") +
  ylab(" normalized movement") +
  ylim(-0.04, 0.1)
```

#D stats
```{r}
# here i cannot use the trick from the neuronal data of taking the max in a small window. with this data it had a huge effect on the significance.

# statsdata <- comb_coord %>%
# filter(Behv != "W2T", chunks == "Post_Airpuff")  %>% group_by(Trial2,id,Behv) %>% summarise(g = mean(diff3))




statsdata <- comb_coord %>%
  filter(Behv != "W2T", chunks == "Post_Airpuff") %>%
  mutate(
    rel_time = framenumber - triggerframe,
    timebin = as.factor(floor(rel_time / 0.05) * 0.05) # 50 ms bins
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, Trial2, Behv, timebin) %>%
  summarise(g = mean(diff3), .groups = "drop")







mod <- glmer(g ~ Behv * timebin + (1 | id), data = statsdata, family = Gamma(link = "inverse"))

res <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = mod, plot = F, refit = F, use.u = T)

plotQQunif(res, testUniformity = F, testOutliers = F, testDispersion = F)




emm <- emmeans(mod, ~ Behv | timebin)
pairs_time <- pairs(emm)

ssss <- as_tibble(summary(pairs_time, infer = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
ssss %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)
```


# E
```{r}
# summarises the data to have 3 values per Trial= mean movement during Airpuff, Post-airpuff and the rest



stat_overall <- Behv_diff2 %>%
  select(framenumber, x2, y2, pc_x, pc_y, triggerframe, Behv, Trial2, id) %>%
  mutate(chunks = case_when(
    between(framenumber, triggerframe, triggerframe + 0.255) ~ "Airpuff",
    between(framenumber, triggerframe + 0.256, triggerframe + 0.505) ~ "Post_Airpuff",
    TRUE ~ "Base" # Default case if none of the above conditions are met
  )) %>%
  group_by(Trial2, Behv, id, chunks) %>%
  summarise(diff_x = sum(pc_x), diff_y = sum(pc_y), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(diff2_x = diff_x / n, diff2_y = diff_y / n) %>%
  mutate(diff3 = (diff2_x + diff2_y) / 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Behv = as.factor(Behv), chunks = factor(chunks, levels = c("Base", "Airpuff", "Post_Airpuff")))


# I included the interaction term because during exploratory plotting i saw that there is less post_airpuff movement in the A2L case

movmod <- glmer(data = stat_overall, diff3 ~ Behv + chunks + Behv * chunks + (1 | id), family = Gamma(link = "log"))
movmod0 <- glmer(data = stat_overall, diff3 ~ 1 + (1 | id), family = Gamma(link = "log"))
anova(movmod, movmod0)

# diagnostic
# the residuals diagnostic plot is worryesome but the results are very similar when using Rank-sum test

res <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = movmod, plot = F, refit = F, use.u = T)
plotQQunif(res, testUniformity = F, testOutliers = F, testDispersion = F)



# Post hoc

pairs(emmeans(movmod, ~ Behv * chunks, adjust = "fdr"))


aaa <- tibble(summary(pairs(emmeans(movmod, ~ Behv * chunks, adjust = "BH")), infer = T))
aaa %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, 4)) %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

# pairs(emmeans(movmod, ~ chunks | Behv))


# plot

interactions::cat_plot(movmod, pred = Behv, modx = chunks, interval = TRUE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 20)
ggsave("E:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/movement_fig/E.svg")
```


# F
```{r}
# get the post airpuff activity in A2L and divide it by the median
match <- stat_overall %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(chunks == "Post_Airpuff") %>%
  mutate(
    cat = cut(diff3,
      breaks = quantile(diff3, probs = seq(0, 1, by = 1 / 2), na.rm = TRUE),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = c("low", "high")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Trial2, diff3, cat)


# only A2L trials with videos, attach whisking amount categories
sc <- combcont %>%
  filter(Trial2 %in% match$Trial2) %>%
  left_join(match)

# average over trials







t_min <- -0.03
t_max <- 0.10
bin_width <- 0.01 # already fixed in data


# ----------------------------
# 1. Trial-level spike rate
# ----------------------------

trial_rates <- sc %>%
  group_by(cat, cluster_id2, Trial2, rel_time) %>%
  summarise(
    rate = sum(event_count, na.rm = TRUE) / bin_width, # Hz
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ----------------------------
# 2. Average across trials (per neuron)
# ----------------------------

neuron_rates <- trial_rates %>%
  group_by(cat, cluster_id2, rel_time) %>%
  summarise(
    neuron_rate = mean(rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ----------------------------
# 3. Z-score per neuron
# ----------------------------

neuron_rates_z <- neuron_rates %>%
  group_by(cat, cluster_id2) %>%
  mutate(
    Zscore =
      (neuron_rate - mean(neuron_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) /
        sd(neuron_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ----------------------------
# 4. Population PSTH
# ----------------------------

pop_psth <- neuron_rates_z %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, t_min, t_max)) %>%
  group_by(cat, rel_time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_z = mean(Zscore, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Zscore, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(), # neurons
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))


# ----------------------------
# 5. Plot
# ----------------------------

ggplot(pop_psth, aes(rel_time, mean_z, col = cat)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_z - se,
      ymax = mean_z + se,
      fill = cat
    ),
    alpha = 0.4,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    col = "darkgrey",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm")
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.03)


ggsave("E:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/movement_fig/F.svg")
```

# F_stats
```{r}
Test_lh_org <- neuron_rates_z %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cluster_id2, names = c("x", "Mouse", "Session"), delim = "_", cols_remove = F) %>%
  unite("id", Mouse, Session) %>%
  distinct(rel_time, Zscore, cluster_id2, id, cat) %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0.01, 0.04)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2, cat, rel_time, id) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore)) %>%
  distinct(cat, cluster_id2, id, Zscore) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  group_by(cat, cluster_id2, id) %>%
  slice_max(Zscore) %>%
  ungroup()

# Test_lh_org <- Trialless_lh %>%
#   distinct(rel_time, Zscore, cluster_id2, id, cat) %>%
#   filter(between(rel_time, 0.01, 0.04)) %>%
#   group_by(cluster_id2, cat, rel_time, id) %>%
#   summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore)) %>%
#   distinct(cat, cluster_id2, id, Zscore) %>%
#   separate_wider_delim(id, names = c("Mouse", "Session"), delim = "_") %>%
#   ungroup() %>%
#   na.omit()

# make all values positive to use gamma distribution
Test_lh <- Test_lh_org %>%
  mutate(Zscore = Zscore - min(Zscore) + 1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(id), as.factor))

# i dropped the random intercept for session because of singularity warning, can probably be fixed with more data
mod_lh <- lme4::glmer(data = Test_lh, Zscore ~ cat + (1 | id), family = Gamma(link = "log"))
mod0 <- lme4::glmer(data = Test_lh, Zscore ~ 1 + (1 | id), family = Gamma(link = "inverse"))

anova(mod_lh, mod0)
summary(mod_lh)

# The fit is questionable but  since all other GLMs use the Gamma and this is almost the same data i decided to stick to it
res <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = mod_lh, plot = T, refit = F, use.u = T)
DHARMa::plotQQunif(res, testUniformity = F, testOutliers = F, testDispersion = F)

pairs(emmeans::emmeans(mod_lh, ~cat))
```
